findings: Author repository identifies winning team; publication describes both simplified and tuned inference, with optional directivity. No supervised training model is required.
Original main defaults to simple inference without directivity. Intake mixes tuned four-filter recipe with optional directivity; these must be explicit execution modes.

Both filter functions ignore threshold argument and call h(X) at default0.11. Sweep call sites pass whole threshold list instead of loop scalar. Full720PCAfits produce only2simple/4tuned distinct matrices; synthetic reproduction recorded.
Tuned preprocessing adds power0.9 and combines global activity with a lagged half-weight sum. w_star receives no filter name, so source always chooses defaultf1 branch even forf3/f4.
PCA aggregation normalizes once after weighted precision summation; intake suggests per-score normalization. Dense threshold averaging is not established as Bayesian model averaging.

Historical PCA whitened basis storage and variance normalization differ from modern sklearn. Pinned historical class executes and precision matches covariance inverse; modern implementation gives materially different precision on same synthetic inputs.
Directivity preprocessing has its own boundary behavior and0.9power transform; precedence inequalities are strict. Final optional directional blend is0.997/0.003.
Source grid contains120entries and110unique thresholds, retaining duplicate values and a gap; do not replace with linspace silently.
